name: Mark Of The Beast
overview: The Scripture reveals the mark of the beast as a symbol of allegiance to the beast described in Revelation 13, who is characterized by blasphemy and power over all people. This mark, received on the hand or forehead, is necessary for commerce and identifies those who worship the beast and his image. The number of the beast, 666, invites discernment and understanding, marking a clear distinction between followers of Christ and those aligned with the beast. The consequences for receiving this mark are severe, including eternal torment without rest, underscoring the gravity of rejecting Christ in favor of the beast.
